Surfer Survives Close Call With Great White Shark in Australia
Brad Ross escaped without injury after a four-meter shark broke his board in half off New South Wales.

A surfer in Australia had a close call with a great white shark that left a large bite mark on his surfboard and broke it in half.
Brad Ross was surfing at Cabarita Beach, a popular beach in the north of the eastern state of New South Wales, on Monday morning, when the approximately four-meter-long shark attacked him,
according to
local media News.com.au.
